name: explore-latency
description: Template only. Copy this, fill in values relative to YOUR card's stock readings from 'nvtune dump', and step one field at a time. Values below are deliberately absent of numbers you should not blindly copy.
applies_to: nothing as written - this is a worked example of the primary latency knobs
notes: Order of impact for random-access workloads: FAW, RRD, RC, RP, RAS, then RD_RCD/CL.
Order of impact for streaming/bandwidth workloads: CCDS, CCDL, W2R_BUS, R2W_BUS, WR.
REFRESH raises the refresh interval, which reclaims bus time but increases retention risk; it is temperature dependent and a bad idea on a cold-plated card running hot VRAM.
Change one field, benchmark, revert, repeat. Two at once tells you nothing.
